items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I got all the Jeanette's and the King Oliver's and the Louis Armstrong's.

ctx.x: Air-conditioned and we have all the collector's items in the record department here, practically all 78s. I got all the Jeanette's and the King Oliver's and the Louis Armstrong's.
Most of your personal collection is here then, is it?
